groups.title: Unit Testing with Vitest
groups.question: You want fast tests for your loaders and actions without running a server or a real database. Explain how you would test them.

followUps.Testing Loaders and Actions in Isolation: Why are loaders and actions easy to test directly?
followUps.Mocking Prisma with Vitest: How would you mock Prisma in these tests?

evidence.text: Loaders and actions are plain async functions.
Tests call them with a constructed Request object.
Tests check the returned data, status or redirect.
The Prisma client is replaced with a mock.
Tests decide what each query returns.
Tests run without a database and give the same result every time.

groups.title: Component Testing
groups.question: Your component tests crash because components use Remix hooks, and accessibility issues are only found manually. Explain how you would test components.

followUps.React Testing Library with Remix Wrapper: Why do components using Remix hooks need a wrapper in tests?
followUps.Accessibility Testing with axe-core: How does axe-core help in component tests?

evidence.text: Hooks like useLoaderData need router context.
A test router or Remix's createRemixStub provides it.
Without it, rendering throws.
axe checks rendered components for accessibility problems.
Running it in tests catches issues on every change.
It finds only part of the issues, so manual checks are still needed.

groups.title: End-to-End Testing with Playwright
groups.question: Your end-to-end tests repeat login steps and break whenever the markup changes. Explain how fixtures and page objects help.

followUps.Playwright Test Setup and Fixtures: What can Playwright fixtures set up for tests?
followUps.Page Object Model Pattern: How do page objects make tests less fragile?

evidence.text: Fixtures provide reusable setup for tests.
Examples include a logged-in user, seeded data and browser contexts.
Tests do not repeat setup steps.

notEnough: Only saying fixtures set up tests.

evidence.text: Page objects wrap a page's selectors and actions.
Tests describe user steps, not HTML details.
Markup changes only require updating the page object.

groups.title: Deployment
groups.question: You are choosing where to deploy your Remix app and a teammate tried to read a secret in client code. Explain adapters and environment variables.

followUps.Remix Server Adapters: What does a Remix server adapter do?
followUps.Environment Variables and .env Files: How should environment variables reach the client?

evidence.text: Adapters connect Remix to a runtime like an Express server or Cloudflare Workers.
Each platform needs the right adapter.
Edge runtimes lack some Node APIs, which affects what code can run.
process.env is only available on the server.
Values the client needs are passed explicitly, for example through loader data.
Secrets are never sent to the client.
